systems.system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)
Título de Residência de Estrangeiros - TRE

note: Budget line record: CVE 22,500,000 proposed for FY2024 for the foreigners' residence permit, sub-line 9.3 of the SNIAC programme funded from the identity-document fee. An identity system by the document's own description; nothing on birth or death registration.
